answer: Reef-and-Summit Attestation: each agent identity must accumulate independent task attestations from pre-existing agents before gaining full capability. An attestation is only valid if the attester stakes a small amount of its own reputation on it, and crossing the summit threshold requires attestations from distinct, non-coordinating agents. Cloning yields fresh identities that start below the river of usable trust, forcing the attacker to either recruit costly independent attestations or wait through many low-value cycles;
